scope: Four low native solids for authored route ground footprints, not original client collisions.
single_shape_source: scripts/route_ground_obstacles.gd reads instantiated native CollisionShape3D shapes; no second obstacle coordinate table.
limits: Only current upright unscaled native circle/box solids supported. Unsupported transforms assert rather than silently changing navigation.
Gate boxes use a conservative rectangle expansion at corners; original central exit trigger remains usable.
Full camera, environment, combat and client collision reconstruction remain outside this bounded change.
